name: Todd Redpath
story: Todd Redpath’s University of Otago research used remote sensing to study Tasman Glacier flow fields and later seasonal snow distribution. He also worked with the Mountain Research Centre and co-convened the 2019 GIS@Otago Symposium with Aubrey Miller.
GeoCart 2016 conference programme, New Zealand Cartographic Society lists Todd Redpath as an author of “Seasonal snowpack mapping with drone photogrammetry”.

Cartographies of change: GeoCart 2018 proceedings, National Library of New Zealand record 40158196 lists Todd Redpath as an author of “Snow depth distribution from high-resolution RPAS photogrammetry”; “RPAS topographic surveys”.
GeoCart session 1 programme, New Zealand Cartographic Society (archived programme page) lists Todd Redpath as an author of “Southern Alps snow resources from satellite photogrammetry”.
GeoCart 2024 session 2 programme, New Zealand Cartographic Society lists Todd Redpath as an author of “Watching the Wetlands”.
New Zealand Geospatial Research Conference 2022 programme, Massey Geoinformatics Collaboratory lists Todd Redpath as an author of “UAV flight and capture parameters for radiata pine quality control”.

Aubrey Miller staff profile: NZGRC 2022 Matariki Project proceedings citation, University of Otago lists Todd Redpath as an author of “The Matariki Project: 3-D change detection with satellite photogrammetric mapping”.
